elaine (docs): Hey team — quick sync: I'm prepping a small examples table for the SOC2 retention page that shows recommended audit-log retention + sample export commands. Wanted to confirm approved phrasing and an SDK snippet.

mike (security): thanks elaine. For SOC2 we can say "Retention: configurable up to 3 years; default 90 days for hosted". Also call out pseudonymization and customer-controlled KMS. Short and clear.

jess (legal): +1 to that phrasing. Add: "Customers are responsible for configuring retention to meet their regulatory requirements." Avoid absolute guarantees about legal sufficiency.

sam (eng-platform): re: export examples — we have a small CLI that does jsonl exports. Suggest using `redwoodctl audit export --start 2024-01-01 --end 2024-02-01 --format jsonl` in examples. Works with Dedicated and Hosted.

elain? typo — oh it's elaine. nina (docs): @elaine I'll draft a 2-row table: columns: use-case | recommended default | note. Row1: dev/debug | 30d | short-term. Row2: compliance | 3y | follow legal. Want me to include a sample SDK snippet (py + curl)?

elaine (docs): yes please include both. For the SDK snippet, let's make it very small and copy-pastable. lucas (sdk): here's a minimal python snippet we can include — feel free to edit:

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
for chunk in c.audit.export(start="2024-01-01", end="2024-02-01", format="jsonl"):
    print(chunk)
```

lucas (sdk): also note that export respects retention and redaction policies; we should call that out in a single sentence.

jess (legal): add a short sentence: "Exports will not contain data already purged per tenant retention settings." Good.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: docs/retention/2024-03-10a -> staging

nina (docs): I'll draft the table and embed lucas's snippet, plus the CLI line sam suggested. @mike can you confirm the KMS line so we phrase it correctly?

mike (security): confirm: "Optional customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; hosted uses Redwood-managed keys with rotation." Keep it short.

elaine (docs): perfect. plan: nina will open a small PR with table + two snippets and a one-paragraph note on retention/export assumptions. tagging @jess and @mike for final signoff. ETA PR today EOD?

nina (docs): yep I'll open PR and ping reviewers. thanks all :thumbsup:
